name: Shashi Rekha
quote: We're delighted to have found Mehul Karotra, a website designer whose exceptional commitment and focus helped bring it all together. We're grateful for his splendid support and the care he's poured into every detail.

name: Vidhi Parmar
quote: I wanted something unique, creative and something that truly feels like me. You understood the vision and brought it to life so beautifully. Couldn't have asked for anything better. Absolutely love what you have created.

name: Store owner
role: Used the free review QR card maker. Sent on WhatsApp
quote: Aapki website se maine apne store ka review card banaya jo bohot hi attractive laga.

name: Prachi
quote: Mehul got the feel of the label before he wrote a line of code. The site reads like our lookbook: calm, editorial, and easy to shop from on a phone.

name: Yash
quote: Site and socials came from one person with one plan. Same voice, same visuals, every week, and I never had to chase anyone for an update.

name: Raj Patel
quote: Clear plan, clear price, and a site that was live when Mehul said it would be. Talking on WhatsApp instead of waiting on email made it painless.

name: Vrushab Jain
quote: Mehul designed and built everything himself, so nothing got lost between a designer and a developer. What we approved in Figma is what went live.
